description: When another tab (or the CLI) already confirmed an identity with different values, Continue shows the raw IDENTITY_EXISTS message "Identity already initialized; linking requires My device" with no hint. It points to device linking, which is irrelevant, and does not offer the real fix (reload/continue as the saved identity).
expected: "You already confirmed your identity as Owen B. in another tab." with a button to continue as that identity (re-reading /session).
actual: Raw message; the identity form and Continue stay in place and fail again if clicked.
suggested_fix: On IDENTITY_EXISTS, refresh /session and move to Welcome, showing a notice naming the saved identity; add a JOIN_HINTS-style entry.

description: A second open tab does not notice that the identity was confirmed elsewhere; it keeps showing the identity form until it is reloaded.
expected: Tabs re-read /session on focus or visibilitychange (or via a BroadcastChannel) and advance automatically.
actual: Tab B stays on Welcome to Pardner until a manual reload.
suggested_fix: Re-fetch the session on window focus while on the identity step.

description: The Start form sentence appends a period after the name, so a name ending in '.' renders as "You join as Owen B.."
suggested_fix: Skip the trailing period when the name already ends with punctuation.
